About me

I'm Mrunalee Makwana, a video editor and graphic designer with a background in healthcare sciences. I moved from microbiology into design and I bring the same precision and attention to detail to every project.

I work full time as a video editor and still take on freelance design and editing projects. That means one person can deliver the reel, the thumbnail and the brand graphics, all in the same visual language. I enjoy turning ideas into visuals that speak.

The reels, designs and logos on this page are a shortlisted selection of my best work.
